**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The document contains no audit, inspection, or verification right that M&I can exercise against Tri City National Bank. All audit-flavoured provisions run in our favour or our regulators':

- **§ 21.4(C) (p0277)** — M&I must procure an annual independent third-party review of *its own* data centre and give us the report free of charge, and implement recommended changes.
- **§ 21.4(B) (p0276)** — examination of records by governmental agencies/Federal Regulators, with a notice duty on M&I.
- **§ 17.1 (p0243) and § 21.8 (p0274)** — Customer Data and the Services remain subject to our auditors and regulatory agencies as if performed on our premises; M&I agrees to submit itself to such examination.
- **§ 22.12 (p0300)** — a one-way reporting duty on M&I, not an audit right (confirming the planner's open question).

The only Customer-side obligation in the vicinity is § 21.7(C)(ii) (p0273), a narrow duty to evidence that the Agreement is properly reflected on our books on request — a confirmation, not an audit or system-access right.

Since nothing binds us on frequency, notice, cost or system access, there is no exposure to constrain and the position is better for us than the playbook's preferred standard. Status recorded as compliant rather than "missing," as the absence of a vendor audit right benefits our party.
